name: Gasthof Mühle
beschreibung: The Gasthof Mühle is a traditional inn in the municipality of Wattenberg in the Wattental. The location is quiet and offers views of the surrounding mountains. The house is family-run and has several guest rooms. The in-house Restaurant serves Tiroler specialties. The surrounding area is ideal for hiking and mountain bike tours. In winter, the Glungezer ski area is easily accessible. Free Wi-Fi and parking are available.
